principles: A short check on payday keeps small leaks from becoming big ones.
Look at what is left after essentials before deciding what to spend.
Move the money you want to keep out of sight straight away.

gentle.title: Payday check-in
gentle.body: Your essentials run to about {essential_monthly_spend} a month and your savings stand at {savings_balance}. A minute now to set aside your savings before spending on anything else is a good habit.

blunt.title: Payday: do this first
blunt.body: Essentials take {essential_monthly_spend} a month and your savings stand at {savings_balance}. Cover the essentials, set savings aside, then spend what is left.
